items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: that's the first time I really had the courage to play along with Bix and play the second part... I got to see Bix all the time there

ctx.x: Well, at the end of that summer-- he was always telling me that he knew Bix and that Bix was out in the Stockton Club -- and that I would be--- and, you know, that I would really like the way he plays but I had heard him play in there somewhere, playing a dance at a college and I heard him play and I couldn't believe--- of course, I had played the trumpet in those days with a lot of muted things -
